question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
-- Final answer: Top 5 constructors with the most seasons where their driver(s) had the fewest total points
WITH driver_season_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           d.driver_id, 
           c.constructor_id,
           c.name as constructor_name,
           SUM(res.points) as total_season_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, d.driver_id, c.constructor_id, c.name
    HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
),
min_points_per_season AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_season_points) as min_points
    FROM driver_season_points
    GROUP BY year
),
fewest_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT dsp.year, dsp.constructor_id, dsp.constructor_name, dsp.total_season_points
    FROM driver_season_points dsp
    JOIN min_points_per_season mps ON dsp.year = mps.year AND dsp.total_season_points = mps.min_points
),
constructor_counts AS (
    SELECT constructor_name, COUNT(*) as num_seasons_as_fewest
    FROM fewest_drivers
    GROUP BY constructor_name
)
SELECT constructor_name, num_seasons_as_fewest
FROM constructor_counts
ORDER BY num_seasons_as_fewest DESC, constructor_name ASC
LIMIT 5
